notes:
### New

- The completion reminder also speaks up when a turn fails or hits a limit, and when a Claude Code session closes in the middle of a turn. The HUD card reads Turn failed, Hit a limit or Session closed and flashes as a warning, and the iPhone's alert says the same. An interrupted turn, or a session quit at its prompt, stays quiet.

### Fixes

- Codex: `list_sessions` offers a steer only when the Codex desktop app or the CLI daemon will take one. The current ChatGPT desktop app doesn't, and a steer to it now says to send with `delivery: queue` instead of failing with "Native owner socket" (#178, thanks @xunhe730).
- Codex desktop: approvals show again with the desktop app's newer stream (version 13, Codex 26.1111 to 26.1116). An extra-permissions request reads as the model's reason, with the network and each folder it asks for on a line of its own, instead of raw JSON. Settings names the Codex hooks still waiting for your review (#184, thanks @Niko-Echo).
- Windows: Return to session for Antigravity brings its window forward, or starts it, when the conversation can't be opened directly, instead of showing its log in File Explorer (#185, thanks @newlandbamboo-afk).
